mapper.sql: id, user_id, problem_slug, source, source_detail_json, origin_plan_id, origin_phase_index, origin_practice_session_id, repetitions, interval_days, fsrs_state, fsrs_step, fsrs_stability, fsrs_difficulty, due_at, lapses, last_reviewed_at, last_rating, archived, user_note_persistent, pending_card_json, pending_card_variant, pending_card_signature, pending_card_generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO mistake_note ( user_id, problem_slug, source, source_detail_json, origin_plan_id, origin_phase_index, origin_practice_session_id, repetitions, interval_days, fsrs_state, fsrs_step, fsrs_stability, fsrs_difficulty, due_at, lapses ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{source}, #{sourceDetailJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{originPlanId}, #{originPhaseIndex}, #{originPracticeSessionId}, #{repetitions}, #{intervalDays}, #{fsrsState}, #{fsrsStep}, #{fsrsStability}, #{fsrsDifficulty}, #{dueAt}, #{lapses} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, problem_slug) DO UPDATE SET source = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.source ELSE mistake_note.source END, source_detail_json = EXCLUDED.source_detail_json, origin_plan_id = COALESCE(mistake_note.origin_plan_id, EXCLUDED.origin_plan_id), origin_phase_index = COALESCE(mistake_note.origin_phase_index, EXCLUDED.origin_phase_index), origin_practice_session_id = COALESCE( mistake_note.origin_practice_session_id, EXCLUDED.origin_practice_session_id), repetitions = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE mistake_note.repetitions END, interval_days = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE mistake_note.interval_days END, fsrs_state = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 'RELEARNING' ELSE COALESCE(mistake_note.fsrs_state, EXCLUDED.fsrs_state) END, fsrs_step = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(mistake_note.fsrs_step, EXCLUDED.fsrs_step) END, fsrs_stability = COALESCE(mistake_note.fsrs_stability, EXCLUDED.fsrs_stability), fsrs_difficulty = COALESCE(mistake_note.fsrs_difficulty, EXCLUDED.fsrs_difficulty), due_at = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE mistake_note.due_at END, lapses = CASE WHEN mistake_note.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN mistake_note.lapses + 1 ELSE mistake_note.lapses END, archived = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING

INSERT INTO mistake_note ( user_id, problem_slug, source, source_detail_json ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{source}, #{sourceDetailJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, problem_slug) DO UPDATE SET source_detail_json = mistake_note.source_detail_json || EXCLUDED.source_detail_json, archived = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING

SELECT FROM mistake_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = FALSE AND due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY CASE fsrs_state WHEN 'RELEARNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'LEARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, (source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' OR lapses > 0) DESC, due_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE mistake_note SET repetitions = #{repetitions}, interval_days = #{intervalDays}, fsrs_state = #{fsrsState}, fsrs_step = #{fsrsStep}, fsrs_stability = #{fsrsStability}, fsrs_difficulty = #{fsrsDifficulty}, lapses = #{lapses}, due_at = #{dueAt}, last_rating = #{lastRating}, last_reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE id = #{noteId} RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE mistake_note SET pending_card_json = #{cardJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, pending_card_variant = #{variant}, pending_card_signature = #{signature}, pending_card_generated_at = #{generatedAt}, updated_at = #{generatedAt} WHERE id = #{noteId}
